# U.S. Census Bureau

> > Official source for U.S. demographic and economic data, providing APIs, datasets, and geographic services from the American Community Survey (ACS) and other census programs.

The Census Bureau collects and disseminates statistical data about the American people and economy. Developers can access data through REST APIs including the ACS datasets and TIGERweb GeoServices for geographic information.

## Key Topics

- American Community Survey (ACS)
- Census Data APIs
- TIGERweb GeoServices
- TIGER Geographic Data
- Developer Resources
- API Catalog
- Federal Relay Service
- Office of the Respondent Advocate
- Regional Offices
- Census Datasets
- Information Quality Guidelines
- Discovery Tool
- Developer Forum
- Suitland Federal Center

## API Reference & Developer Resources

- [Available APIs](https://www.census.gov/data/developers/data-sets.html): Catalog of Census Bureau APIs including ACS and other public datasets
- [Census TIGERweb GeoServices REST API](https://www.census.gov/data/developers/data-sets/TIGERweb-map-service.html): GeoServices REST API for TIGER geographic data and GIS mapping services

## Documentation & Guidelines

- [Citing our Data, Tools, Technical Documents and Research](https://www.census.gov/about/policies/citation.html): Guidelines for citing Census Bureau data and research in various formats

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.census.gov/about/contact-us.html): Contact info for Census Bureau: phone 1-800-923-8282, regional offices
- [Resources and FAQs](https://www.census.gov/about/census-careers/resources.html): Job application FAQs and resources for Census Bureau careers via USAJOBS

## Optional

- [Correction Procedures](https://www.census.gov/about/policies/quality/corrections.html): Data correction procedures per OMB Information Quality Guidelines
- [National Advisory Committee (NAC)](https://www.census.gov/about/cac/nac.html): Archived NAC committee that advised Census on reaching diverse populations
